main_visual_task: Sunrise light itself wakes the coffee - a single beam travels from window to bean to grind to bloom to pour across five unequal shots, the procedure dissolved into one luminous journey.

user_script_review.note: A段v2「光的旅程」不等长分镜获用户批准；原则：观众不需要完整工序，工序完整也须做镜头叙事变化

prompt_bible.subject_lock: one real barista seen only as a silhouette in steam at the end of this segment, wearing a charcoal linen apron over a plain white shirt, natural human proportions, plus the unlabeled glass pour-over set, bean jar and gooseneck kettle; no branding anywhere
prompt_bible.environment_lock: a small modern city cafe interior before opening, wooden counter, rain-fresh window, soft blue pre-dawn light warming into sunrise, no other people inside or outside
prompt_bible.material_lock: real human skin with visible pores and micro-texture, real linen and cotton fabric weave, real oily beans, fine coffee powder, glass refraction, crema bubbles and rising steam, all physically plausible
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: one hard warm sunrise beam entering from upper left and traveling shot to shot, with a fixed cool blue fill from the window
prompt_bible.palette_lock: deep espresso brown, morning gold, cool window blue, charcoal linen gray, cream white
prompt_bible.lens_texture: live-action 35mm commercial cinematography on a real cinema camera, true-to-life photographic rendering, natural skin subsurface scattering, practical light falloff, filmic contrast, shallow macro depth of field
prompt_bible.screen_direction: the sunrise beam and all energy travel left-to-right across cuts; label areas remain blank
prompt_bible.audio_policy: diegetic rhythm only: a low dawn hum, bean cascade, one long bloom breath, glass chime, final pour; no voice and no dialogue

internal_shots.visual_state: near-black pre-dawn macro, one glossy roasted bean fills the whole frame
internal_shots.subject_action: the first blade of sunrise enters from frame left and ignites the bean's edge
internal_shots.camera_action: locked macro with only the light moving
internal_shots.lighting_state: one hard warm blade crossing cool darkness
internal_shots.end_state: the lit edge flares as the beam strengthens

camera_plan.motivation: open on wonder, not on context
camera_plan.start_position: extreme macro filling the frame with the single bean
camera_plan.path: camera locked in total stillness while the light blade crosses
camera_plan.focus_transition: dark bean surface to ignited rim
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut exactly when the rim flare peaks

internal_shots.visual_state: the same beam now cuts through the grinder as a waterfall of beans drops through it, seen from a low backlit angle
internal_shots.subject_action: beans tumble through the light blade, each catching a specular glint before vanishing into the burrs
internal_shots.camera_action: one quick upward tilt following the falling bean stream
internal_shots.lighting_state: hard backlight turns the bean waterfall into sparks
internal_shots.end_state: the last glint dies as the stream ends

camera_plan.motivation: let the light, not the worker, move to the next station
camera_plan.start_position: low angle at the grinder mouth
camera_plan.path: tilt upward along the falling stream toward its bright source
camera_plan.focus_transition: falling beans to the bright stream top
camera_plan.end_position: low angle looking into the light
camera_plan.axis_lock: tilt vertical only while beans fall toward camera
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the last bean leaves the light

internal_shots.visual_state: one continuous breathing macro - the grounds cone forms, a thin water spiral sweeps across, the bed swells into a bubbling bloom crust, then settles into a mirror pool
internal_shots.subject_action: the coffee bed rises, exhales steam and glistening oils, and falls still like a breath completing
internal_shots.camera_action: one slow continuous orbit across the whole transformation, never cutting
internal_shots.focus: spiral tongue to swelling crust to settling mirror
internal_shots.lighting_state: the sunrise key strokes through passing steam
internal_shots.end_state: a mirror-still dark pool ready to draw

camera_plan.motivation: dissolve the procedure into one living process
camera_plan.start_position: low macro at coffee bed level
camera_plan.path: orbit a slow sixty-degree arc around the bed while it transforms
camera_plan.speed_curve: constant slow drift matching the breath of the bed
camera_plan.focus_transition: water spiral to crust bubbles to mirror pool
camera_plan.end_position: low macro on the still pool
camera_plan.axis_lock: one clockwise drift with no vertical movement
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut on the instant the pool turns mirror-still

internal_shots.visual_state: seen through the curved glass wall of the carafe, the amber pour distorts and refracts while bubbles rise inside
internal_shots.subject_action: the liquid column bends through the glass and streams of bubbles climb
internal_shots.camera_action: one slow push-in toward the refraction
internal_shots.focus: the distorted column and rising bubbles
internal_shots.lighting_state: the sunrise key splits into caustic ribbons inside the glass
internal_shots.end_state: the carafe fills into a glowing amber volume

camera_plan.motivation: break the eye-level routine with optics
camera_plan.start_position: close-up on the curved carafe wall
camera_plan.path: push slowly toward the refracted pour inside the glass
camera_plan.focus_transition: glass surface to refracted column to rising bubbles
camera_plan.end_position: extreme close-up through the glass at the amber core
camera_plan.axis_lock: push perpendicular to the glass wall only
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut on the full amber glow

internal_shots.visual_state: the barista's silhouette stands in a haze of backlit steam finishing the pour at the counter
internal_shots.subject_action: the kettle lifts away and the silhouette settles while steam curls through the light
internal_shots.camera_action: one smooth pull back letting the lit scene breathe
internal_shots.focus: the steam veil and the silhouette's outline
internal_shots.lighting_state: full sunrise floods the haze gold against cool shadow
internal_shots.end_state: the counter glows with the finished brew and the silhouette rests

camera_plan.motivation: return the human as atmosphere, not as procedure
camera_plan.start_position: medium close behind the steam veil
camera_plan.path: pull straight back through the steam to a wide counter view
camera_plan.focus_transition: steam veil to lit counter to silhouette edge
camera_plan.end_position: wide framing of the glowing counter
camera_plan.axis_lock: pull back along the light axis only
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the scene settles into the glow

first_frame: near-black macro of a single glossy coffee bean as the first blade of sunrise ignites its edge
last_frame: wide view of the barista silhouette in backlit steam above the glowing finished brew
